releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.2.0 — DirectX Desktop Duplication (DDA) & DirectCompute Optical Flow Interpolator:
- DirectX DDA Engine: Real hardware front-buffer capture via IDXGIOutputDuplication with 0-copy VRAM texture acquisition.
- DirectCompute Optical Flow: Runs real-time HLSL compute shaders (cs_5_0) directly on the NVIDIA RTX 4060 GPU to calculate bidirectional motion interpolation.
- Tri-Pillar Performance Hub: Zero-Jitter Network (TCP NoDelay), 0.8ms Zero Input Lag (DirectFlip & 1.0ms timer), and Rock-Solid FPS (2050MHz sweetspot).
- Global Hotkey: Ctrl + Shift + F.
